description: Lists the field sets an order can deliver, such as standard or standard_telephone, with their exact columns. Every field set costs 1 credit a record, with no telephone, download or API surcharge. Use it to pick the field_set for quote_order; it is free and needs no account. Lawful basis is UK GDPR Article 6(1)(f) legitimate interests; email audiences include corporate subscribers only by default (PECR), so sole traders and ordinary partnerships are left out unless the toggle is changed.

cursor.description: An opaque cursor from next_cursor. Pass it back unchanged.
